I calculated each order’s value as quantity × unit price × (1 − discount percentage). Only completed orders count toward net revenue.

- **q1:** March completed orders total **£10,540.05**.
- **q2:** Q2 completed net revenue by region: West £10,871.20; East £7,744.55; South £6,659.25; North £971.35. **West** was highest.
- **q3:** Desk Lamp net revenue rose from £1,109.60 in Q1 to £3,028.60 in Q2, an increase of about **172.9%**.
- **q4:** Discounted order value from refunded and cancelled orders totalled **£15,181.05**.
- **q5:** Northwind Recruitment had the highest January–June net revenue, at **£10,144.95**.
- **q6:** Q1 net revenue was £46,046.35 across 57 completed orders, giving an average of **£807.83**.
